purpose: G-15: compare the critic with no lens, each single lens, and the lens mix under identical conditions, to observe whether lenses change defect detection or false rejection on sealed cases.
precondition: The critic configuration has passed release-v1 qualification (qualification_design.json); before that no effect comparison is run.

conditions.note: keeps every default critic function; nothing is removed to make lenses look better

dataset: a sealed set authored under the release-v1 rules and not used for qualification
measurements: per case and condition: verifier verdict and boundary class
paired differences between each lens condition and no_lens on the same case
cost and call counts per condition
reporting: observed counts and paired differences only, with every invalid trial listed; no superiority claim is made in v1
never_claimed: that a lens improves the critic in general
